Runtime notices for the combined Railway image

The image contains the following runtime components and their complete upstream
license texts, served beside this notice:

- FrankenPHP v1.13.0, MIT: frankenphp-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/dunglas/frankenphp/tree/v1.13.0
- Caddy v2.11.7, Apache-2.0: caddy-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/tree/v2.11.7
- PHP 8.5.11, PHP License: php-LICENSE.txt
  https://github.com/php/php-src/tree/php-8.5.11

Debian Bookworm package copyright and license notices remain in
/usr/share/doc/<package>/copyright in the image. This list does not claim to be
a complete audit of every module statically linked into FrankenPHP/Caddy; inspect
the exact image's software inventory before transferring it outside this repo.
